research_purpose: Evaluate how a concise reference synthesis can serve as a navigation baseline for Tree of Sophia while every historical assertion is decomposed to direct scholarship and source-returnable evidence. The local study would compare the article's terminology and claims with established and fresh research, measure unsupported-assertion and returnability failures, and improve provenance-aware indexing. It is not model development or training.
requested_format: Permission to make one access-controlled local machine-readable research copy of the current article text and metadata, retain source fixity and provenance, run local transcription normalization, indexing, retrieval, embeddings, and computer-assisted comparison, and quote only bounded passages with attribution. No public article body, image, content-bearing derivative, model training corpus, server-hosted processing copy, or redistribution is requested.

local_storage_conditions.retention_posture: Retain only under Britannica's written conditions; preserve exact revision and fixity metadata; keep article bytes, extracted text, embeddings, and content-bearing derivatives local and removable; publish neither the article nor restricted derivatives.
